verses.1: He led me to the outer courtyard, along the northern path. He brought me to the room that faced away from the garden and away from the trees. It was facing towards the north.
verses.2: At the end of the hundred amos, there is a door that leads to the opening and the expansion. It’s fifty amos in length.
verses.3: Opposite to the twenty who are in the inner courtyard, and opposite to the floor that is in the outer courtyard, there is Atik El-Feney Atik in the thirty.
verses.4: And before the flames spread, they traveled for twelve hours toward the inner part of the fire. Their openings led towards the surface.
verses.5: And the narrow passages leading upward were so small that they could only be used by those who were able to climb up from below and from above.
verses.6: For they are three in number, and they have no supports like those of the gardens. Therefore, they are lifted up from the ground by those who are beneath them and from the sides of the earth.
verses.7: And the wall that separated the courtyards from each other was fifty amahs in length.
verses.8: For the distance from the gate to the inner courtyard is fifty amahs. And now, on the surface of the room itself, there are another hundred amahs.
verses.9: And from beneath these branches, those who come from the past, they enter here from outside the fence.
verses.10: In the middle of the garden, along the path leading to the front of the building, and also in front of the buildings, for sleeping.
verses.11: And their path ahead resembled the shapes of those who walked along the shore. It was long and wide, with all its features and details clearly visible.
verses.12: And at the entrance of the streets, which lead to the temple, there is a path that leads to the front of the gate. This is the path that leads to the entrance.
verses.13: And he said to the priests, “Let those who are near to God be placed in that holy place. There, the priests who are close to God will place there the sacred objects, the offerings, and the sins and offenses. For that place is holy.”
verses.14: When the priests came, they did not leave the holy place and go to the outer courtyard. There, they laid aside their clothes, as if they were still in a state of holiness. Then they changed into other clothes and offered sacrifices to the Lord.
verses.15: And he destroyed all the doors of the inner room, and led me out through the door that faced towards the Kedim. He surrounded it on all sides.
verses.16: The spirit of the ancients measured five thousand units when buying land. They measured around that amount when purchasing land.
verses.17: The wind’s breath measured five cubits around the circle of the measurement.
verses.18: The spirit of Darrowam increased in size by five hands during the purchase of Midah.
verses.19: He went to the spirit of the sea. He measured five cubits in length in the place where the Midianites lived.
verses.20: In four directions, it surrounded him with warmth. Its length was five cubits, and its width was also five cubits. This helped to distinguish between the sacred and the profane.
